#     **Advent Of Chaos**
    
A new content beyond netherite, a new development for your End-Game.

This new ''beginning'' is focused on the Wither Boss, that is, from the heart of the Wither, the Nether Star.


<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

This mod is just a hobby of mine, so updates may take a while to be released.

</details>
